children: Public Storage completed acquisition of PS Canada for approximately $1.2 billion, adding 68 facilities (5.3M sq ft) to its portfolio.
Acquired all membership interests of PS Canada, adding 68 self-storage facilities totaling ~5.3M net rentable sq ft.
Purchase price at closing ~ $1.2 billion: ~ $900M in PSA OP units (2,762,108 units at $321.98/unit) and ~ $310M cash.
Sellers eligible for up to 768,000 additional PSA OP units (valued at $375/unit) as earn-out tied to NOI targets.
PSOC drew $500M delayed draw term loan on Aug 31, 2026 in connection with the closing.
Company expects acquisition to be accretive to long-term IRR, NOI growth, and FFO per share; near-term high single-digit compounding NOI growth targeted.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Public Storage completes $1.2B acquisition of PS Canada, adds 68 Canadian facilities
